lugia.title: LuGia Dental Practice – Website with Local SEO
lugia.short: Live website for a dental practice in Córdoba: 8 pages, appointments via WhatsApp, local SEO, Google Analytics tracking and a configured Google Business Profile listing.
lugia.long: Production website (lugia.com.ar) for a dentist's practice in Córdoba, built so that patients in the neighbourhood can find her on Google and request an appointment in a minute. It has a home page with treatments, the professional, the practice, FAQ and contact, plus seven dedicated pages, one per treatment (endodontics, paediatric dentistry, prosthetics and crowns, implants, bruxism splints, whitening and dental cleaning), each with its own palette, illustration and FAQ. Appointments are requested through a four-step form that builds the message and opens it in WhatsApp, with no backend and no data stored. Beyond the site, I also handled the Google presence: I set up Google Analytics to measure visits and built the practice's Google Business Profile listing, with a direct link to leave reviews and directions through Google Maps. Every page is generated as static HTML at build time, with its own title, description and structured data, a sitemap and robots.txt, and the copy is written for local searches ("in Córdoba", "Jardín Horizonte").
lugia.objective: Give a private practice a professional web presence: show up in searches in its area, explain each treatment clearly and turn visits into WhatsApp appointments.
features: 8 pages: home plus one per treatment, each with its own title, description and structured data
4-step appointment form that builds the message and opens it in WhatsApp, storing no data
Floating WhatsApp button on desktop and fixed bar on mobile
Pages generated as static HTML at build time (SSR), with sitemap.xml and robots.txt
Local SEO focused on Córdoba and the neighbourhood
Google Analytics configured to measure visits, with a cookie notice
Google Business Profile listing set up, with a review link and directions
Each treatment with its own colour range, photo shape and SVG illustration
Tool on the cleaning page that works out when the next check-up is due
Ink cursor and animations with GSAP and Motion, honoring the reduced-motion preference
Automated Playwright tests on desktop and mobile: they fill in the form and walk the sitemap
Responsive design and informative copy in a friendly tone
learnings: Building a multi-page site with React and Vite and generating it as static HTML for SEO
Local SEO: per-page titles and descriptions, structured data, sitemap and content written for local searches
Setting up Google Analytics and Google Business Profile for a real business
Turning visits into appointments with a simple WhatsApp flow and no backend
Animations with GSAP and Motion, with attention to performance and accessibility
Working with a real client: content, tone, photos and publishing on a custom domain

consultorio-odontologico.title: Management System for a Dental Practice
consultorio-odontologico.short: Web system to manage patients, treatments, payments, lab expenses and financial reports for a dental practice.
consultorio-odontologico.long: Web system built so a dentist can manage her activity inside a shared practice. Its main goal is not scheduling appointments, but organizing the financial and operational information around patients, treatments, payments, lab expenses and outstanding balances. The application lets her add patients and attach treatments with their prices and the split percentages agreed between the dentist and the practice. It also records partial cash payments, shows remaining balances and links lab expenses to treatments. It includes monthly, weekly and pending-payment reports, showing the balances owed to the dentist, the practice and the lab. Payments are distributed in cascade: first they cover the lab, then the dentist's balance and finally the practice's balance.
consultorio-odontologico.objective: Build an internal tool that improves the financial management of a dentist working inside a shared practice.

presupuestos-vidrieria.title: Quoting System for a Glass Shop
presupuestos-vidrieria.short: Web app to calculate, save and send glass quotes based on dimensions, thickness, glass type and surface area.
presupuestos-vidrieria.long: Web system built for a glass shop, designed to automate quote calculation based on dimensions, thickness, glass type and surface area. Quotes can be saved to a list, reviewed later and sent over WhatsApp. The backend has a modular structure that separates controllers, routes, models and middlewares for more maintainable and scalable code. It also includes authentication with JWT and bcrypt to protect access to the system.
presupuestos-vidrieria.objective: Automate quote calculation for a glass shop and make it easier to organize and communicate with customers.
learnings: Connecting React to a REST API
Building a solution for a real business

api-ecommerce.title: E-commerce Backend API
api-ecommerce.short: REST API to manage users, products and orders in an e-commerce, with JWT authentication, roles, validations and automated tests.
api-ecommerce.long: Backend system built to manage an e-commerce, handling users, products and orders through a REST API built with Node.js, Express and MongoDB. It includes sign-up and login, JWT authentication, password hashing with bcrypt and role-based authorization. Administrators can manage products, users and orders, while customers can place orders and check their history. The project is organized in layers, separating controllers, routes, models, middlewares, configuration and tests. It also has a separate testing database and 24 automated tests with Jest and Supertest.
api-ecommerce.objective: Build a robust REST API for an e-commerce, applying secure authentication, role-based authorization, MongoDB persistence, validations, error handling and automated testing.
features: Automated tests with Jest and Supertest
learnings: Handling business rules such as stock and orders

turnos-psiquiatria.title: Appointment System for a Psychiatry Practice
turnos-psiquiatria.short: Web system to create, search and manage medical appointments, with login, advanced filters and patient status tracking.
turnos-psiquiatria.long: Web system built to manage a psychiatrist's appointments, letting her add patients and organize visits from a simple, functional interface. Appointments are recorded with data such as patient name, ID number, claim number, date and time. A side list shows the loaded appointments and can be filtered by name, ID, claim number, exact date or date ranges. Each appointment changes status as it is followed up: to be notified, notified, attended or absent. Access is protected by login with JWT authentication and bcrypt-hashed passwords.
turnos-psiquiatria.objective: Create a secure, practical web tool to record, search and control medical appointments.
features: Name, ID and claim number records

landing-vidrieria.title: Landing Page for Villarroel Glass Shop
landing-vidrieria.short: Commercial landing page for a glass shop, with an inquiry form and an admin panel to view quote requests.
landing-vidrieria.long: Website built for a glass shop, focused on presenting its services, capturing inquiries from potential customers and making quote requests easy from a modern, responsive landing page. The project includes a backend with Node.js, Express and MongoDB to store the inquiries sent from the form. It also has an admin section where the business can see the requests received and manage contact with customers more effectively.
landing-vidrieria.objective: Create a professional digital presence for a glass shop, showcasing its services, attracting interested customers and centralizing inquiries in an admin panel.
learnings: Connecting forms to a REST API

control-habitos.title: Habit Tracking App
control-habitos.short: Web app to log personal consumption, with user login, notes, exact-time history and monthly reports.
control-habitos.long: Web app built as a personal tool to log and track cigarette or tobacco consumption. Different users can sign in and keep their own separate records. The app has a main button to quickly add a record. When logging, the user can choose tobacco or cigarette, add notes, and the exact time is saved automatically. It also includes a reports section where the amount logged per month can be checked and the total reviewed by label or category.
control-habitos.objective: Create a simple, functional app to log personal consumption, view the daily history and get monthly reports.

landing-semillas.title: Landing Page for a Seed Shop
landing-semillas.short: Aesthetic landing page mockup for a seed shop, built with basic HTML and CSS.
landing-semillas.long: Web mockup built as a landing page for a seed shop, focused mainly on aesthetics, visual identity and commercial presentation. The project was made with basic HTML and CSS, with no dynamic features or backend connection. Its main goal was to practice web layout, visual organization of content, typographic hierarchy, use of color, commercial sections and the overall composition of a presentation page.
landing-semillas.objective: Design a visually appealing landing page to practice web layout, HTML structure, CSS styling and the commercial presentation of a brand.
features: Visual blocks for products or categories

rachagym.title: RachaGym – Workout Tracking App
rachagym.short: Web app to log the days you train each week and hit a weekly goal, with invite-only access, an admin panel and password recovery by email.
rachagym.long: Full stack web app to keep track of workouts week by week. Each user sets a goal of days (from 1 to 7) and marks the days they train; a progress ring shows how much is left, and marking a day triggers confetti, sound and animations that switch off if the user prefers reduced motion. Changes show up instantly and sync with the server, rolling back to the previous state if something fails. There is no public signup: an admin creates users from a panel and they receive an email invitation, with password recovery included. The backend is a REST API built with Node.js, Express and MongoDB, with one tracker per user per week starting on Monday, based on a configurable time zone. It went through a technical audit that fixed security issues (restricted CORS, rate limiting, helmet headers, ReDoS protection and errors that no longer leak internal details) and has 44 automated tests.
rachagym.objective: Build a complete, secure weekly tracking app, caring both for the user experience and the robustness of the backend: authentication, role-based access, security and testing.
features: Users created only by admins, with email invitation
Weekly goal configurable from 1 to 7 days
Progress ring toward the week's goal
Confetti, sounds and animations, honoring the reduced-motion preference
Rate limiting on login and password recovery
44 automated tests with Jest and Supertest
learnings: Designing a layered REST API with Express and Mongoose
Idempotent, atomic MongoDB operations to avoid duplicates
Handling weeks and time zones on the server
Optimistic updates on the frontend with rollback on errors
API security: CORS, rate limiting, helmet, ReDoS and error handling
Sending emails with SMTP and a test inbox
Endpoint testing and deploying frontend and backend separately

rp-odontologia.title: RP Odontología – Dental Clinic Management System
rp-odontologia.short: Web system to manage patients, treatments, payments, expenses and reports for a dental clinic, with configurable roles and permissions and a KPI dashboard.
rp-odontologia.long: Full stack application to run the day-to-day of a dental clinic in one place. Each patient has a record and a treatment history; each treatment has an agreed price and moves through a lifecycle of states (in progress, finished, cancelled) with controlled transitions. Payments, with their payment method, and related expenses are recorded against the treatment, and the system works out on its own how much has been collected and how much is still pending. A dashboard and a reports module answer the business questions: how much is collected, how much each procedure and each payment method brings in, how much is spent, the net result for the period and the state of the treatment portfolio. Lists are paginated, with search and filters. Access is controlled with roles and permissions: an administrator creates roles, chooses what each one can do and registers users, and both the interface and the API enforce those permissions. Data is isolated per clinic, payments and expenses are never deleted but voided with a reason, and every change is logged in an audit table. The backend is a modular REST API built with Node.js, Express and MySQL, with JWT login, password recovery by email, rate limiting, restricted CORS and versioned SQL migrations on top of an existing database.
rp-odontologia.objective: Replace the manual management of a dental clinic with a system that centralizes patients, treatments and finances, with role-based access control and reports that support decision making.
features: JWT login with passwords hashed with bcrypt
Configurable roles and permissions, enforced in the API and the interface
Patient management with search by first name, last name or ID number, plus deactivation and reactivation
Treatments with an agreed price and states with valid transitions
Payments with payment method and automatic pending-balance calculation
Voiding of payments and expenses with a reason, without deleting the record
Audit log of changes to treatments, payments and expenses
Dashboard with KPIs for the period
Reports on income, expenses, net result, income by treatment type and by payment method, pending collections and monthly evolution
Manageable catalogs: states, payment methods, expense types and treatment types
Paginated lists with filters and validated forms
learnings: Relational modeling in MySQL and incremental SQL migrations on a database with real data
Designing a layered, modular REST API with Express
End-to-end role and permission based access control (RBAC)
Business rules: states with transitions, balances and traceable voiding
SQL aggregation queries for reports and indicators
API security: JWT, rate limiting, restricted CORS and data validation
Organizing a React frontend by modules with protected routes
